description: Source file implementing the VssCommandProcessor class, which handles processing of various commands such as update, get, and authorize in a VSS (Vehicle Signal Specification) context. It includes methods for processing update requests, metadata retrieval, authorization, and query parsing.

classes.name: VssCommandProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing various VSS commands such as update, get, and authorization, managing interactions with database, logger, and validation components.

methods.name: processUpdateVSSTree
methods.description: Handles updating the VSS tree with provided metadata, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: processGetMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified VSS path, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: processUpdateMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata for a specified VSS path, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: processAuthorize
methods.description: Performs authorization based on a token, returning TTL or error.

methods.name: processQuery
methods.description: Parses and processes incoming JSON requests, routing to specific handlers based on action.
